dialogues.speaker: Zhemchuzhina
dialogues.text: Shh... I'm watching the dogs chat.

dialogues.speaker: Zhemchuzhina
dialogues.text: Alyosha told me that dogs are really smart, and I guess they speak a language of their own.

dialogues.speaker: Zhemchuzhina
dialogues.text: I want to learn it too, so I can talk to them.
